{{Quote|You're not worried some of them may still be alive to come after us?"<br />"I doubt they're that stupid."<br />"You think a group called the "League of Bounty Hunters" is full of geniuses?|Connor Freeman and Boba Fett|<ref name="Blood Ties: A Tale of Jango and Boba Fett 2">[[Blood Ties 2|''Blood Ties'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''League of Bounty Hunters''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] organization led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Daquinn]]. The entire league was wiped out when they crossed paths with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] while hunting [[Connor Freeman]].
